book.title: Barbarians at the Gate: The Fall of RJR Nabisco
book.description: Written in a can't-put-down, novelistic style and filled with portraits of money men and their beautiful wives, this riveting account of the $25 billion battle for RJR Nabisco recounts the two-month story of how an old-line powerhouse became the victim of 1980's ruthless financial scheme. Illustrated.
